ul.li: 1a: CDI Permissions setup for Cloud Data Platform
1b: CDI Account connects to Braze dataset (dw_* tables)
1c: CDI Account accesses source tables (Table X, Y, Z)
2a: Transform query selects data from XYZ tables
2b: Transform inserts into BrazeIngestion.Users with XYZ values
2: Braze listener checks UPDATED_AT every 15 minutes
Cloud Data Platform: Any supported data warehouse
CDI (Cloud Data Ingestion): Braze's data import framework
Transform Query: Maps source data to Braze user schema
UPDATED_AT: Timestamp field for incremental sync
15-minute Listener: Braze polls for new/updated rows

ol.li: Source tables in cloud platform contain raw data
Transform query reshapes data for Braze schema
Data inserted into cdi_ingestion with UPDATED_AT timestamp
Braze listener pulls new rows every 15 minutes
User data updated in Braze for segmentation and campaigns

ul.li: Platform Agnostic: Works with any cloud warehouse
Transform on Source: Data shaping in SQL
No API Limits: Bulk data ingestion

text.tspan: Braze has a listener that checks for
15 minutes to pull new rows into Braze
